act_name: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018 (Act XXXIV of 2018)
title: Trafficking in persons
verbatim_text: Any person who recruits, harbours, transports, provides or obtains another person, or attempts to do so, for compelled labour or commercial sex acts, through the use of force, fraud or coercion, commits the offence of trafficking in persons and shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years and fine which may extend to one million rupees.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018 (Act XXXIV of 2018)

act_name: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018 (Act XXXIV of 2018)
title: Aggravated trafficking in persons
verbatim_text: Whoever commits trafficking in persons in respect of a child or a woman, or where the offence involves organized criminal groups, torture or life-threatening harm, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than seven years and may extend to fourteen years and fine which shall not be less than one million rupees.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018 (Act XXXIV of 2018)

act_name: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018 (Act XXXIV of 2018)
title: Cognizability and non-bailable nature of offences
verbatim_text: All offences punishable under this Act shall be cognizable, non-bailable and non-compoundable.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018 (Act XXXIV of 2018)
